gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-monda: Monda reads friendly and uncluttered, with small counters that stay open instead of filling in. And Comic Relief is the loud one here, every curve as thick as its stems and bowls left unfinished on one side.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-mooli: Mooli keeps its round letters open and legible at small sizes. Comic Relief hits hard with unfinished bowls that never thin at the sides, while Mooli simply gets on with being a contemporary sans-serif.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-murecho: Murecho reads modern and tidy, its s curves opening wide at both ends so each line feels unhurried. But Comic Relief earns its keep big and short, where a stroke of unit width throughout can really make itself known.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-nanum-gothic: Nanum Gothic reads as a contemporary plain sans, with wide channels leading into every counter so the letters never feel crowded. And over a long passage it would move along smoothly, while Comic Relief's constant-ink stripes stay confined to the heading.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-national-park: Clean and rounded, National Park draws each letter with a clearly open side. Comic Relief up top is the heavy hitter, so give the body text the size adjustment and leave the heading alone.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-niramit: Niramit reads crisp and businesslike, its curves gaping wide open in every letter. And Comic Relief sits above it with no swelling where curves meet stems, so the heading and the sans body feel like two different voices sharing a page.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-noto-sans-canadia: Noto Sans Canadian Aboriginal reads neutral and contemporary, with openness at the end of every curve it draws. Comic Relief's modulation-free strokes go above it.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-noto-sans-cypriot: Approachable is the first word for Noto Sans Cypriot, whose e opens up rather than closing its eye. And across a longer stretch it stays easygoing, while Comic Relief's thin-looking letters carry no thinner parts at all.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-noto-sans-cypro-m: Heavy cable-like outlines on top, with no thick-thin shift anywhere in Comic Relief. Noto Sans Cypro Minoan sits underneath with terminals cut back to leave a big gap, giving the page a lighter counterweight.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-noto-sans-hanifi-: Approachable and modern, Noto Sans Hanifi Rohingya shows a visibly gaping c at any size, while Comic Relief skips calligraphic shading entirely. Over many lines it would read easily.
